d:
Some comedies make you laugh. Some make you nostalgic. And then there’s Pati Patni Aur Woh Do, a film that desperately wants to be a comedy of errors but forgets the comedy part entirely.
In this episode of First Cut, Dabeet Singh reviews the latest starrer that attempts to recreate the charm of middle-class Bollywood comedies but struggles with weak writing, predictable storytelling, and punchlines that rarely land.
Despite committed performances from and , the film, feels stuck between wanting to be quirky and chaotic without fully succeeding at either.
